name: TrackJS
summary: TrackJS tracks JavaScript errors in the browser. Plans are priced by page views and apps, not by error count: Starter is $49 a month for 100,000 page views and one app, Professional $99, and Business $199. Limits are soft, and seats are unlimited.

facts.text: TrackJS applies a source map to a minified stack trace when the script carries a sourceMappingUrl, and formats minified files when no map exists.
Errors are grouped by rules written in a dashboard group builder or by an onError callback in the agent that edits the report before it is sent.
Notification channels are email, Slack and Microsoft Teams, and daily summaries go by email only.
The page version comes from a meta tag set at build time, such as a Git revision, and is attached to each reported error.
Plan limits are soft: going over prompts an upgrade, and the pricing page says the service keeps working.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: 100,000 page views, 1 app, 10-day retention, 20 errors a minute. Yearly billing shows $45 a month

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: 1 million page views, 5 apps, 15-day retention, 60 errors a minute. Yearly billing shows $91 a month

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: 5 million page views and up, 10 apps, 30-day retention, 90 errors a minute. Yearly billing shows $183 a month

hiddenCosts: Each plan allows a fixed number of apps, and the error rate limit per minute rises only with the plan.
The page shows a free trial on each paid plan without stating how long it lasts.
